diagnostic_findings.finding: No OOD rejection gate was wired into the analyzer. Saved noise and OFDM captures received near-certain 16QAM softmax scores; entropy was low and the existing adaptive energy detector rejected all saved capture types, so it was not suitable as a signal-presence gate. Old Mahalanobis thresholds were not reproducible.

T2-01, T2-02, T2-07, and T2-08 labels changed to their correct PSK classes when applying measured CFO to classifier input. Raw capture, features, feature order, normalization, and ONNX model remained unchanged. This is a classifier/DSP compatibility issue, not evidence of model domain shift.

T2-03 independent interleaver, K7 Viterbi, and CRC paths agreed on the true encoded bits. First divergence was demodulation after carrier recovery rejected a phase estimate; CRC and supplied expected payload length then selected the valid phase.

T2-05 trace verified stereo channel order (I=channel 0,Q=channel 1), PCM scaling, and 1 MHz rate. A QPSK 45-degree phase anchor was omitted in carrier recovery. The corrected path reports four unresolved rotations; an offline reference comparison found an exact rotation but the analyzer did not select it. WAV loader was not changed.

T2-07 baseline took 2618.441 seconds with a CFO-driven 8PSK label and many structurally impossible trials. Structural length/divisibility preflight preserved compatible candidates and the ground-truth candidate.
